## Service: conversation-ai (Conversation AI API)

Documentation for AI Employees API

### Attach Action to Agent
POST /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/create-action | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/create-action.md

Creates and attach a new action for an AI agent. Actions define specific tasks or behaviors that the agent can perform, such as booking appointments, sending follow-ups, collecting information, or making an external API call via the `customApi` ("API Call") type. For `customApi`, put the config in `details` (`details.apiConfig` is required) and a per-agent limit (up to 5) applies.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: conversation-ai.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- agentId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - The unique identifier of the AI agent

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateActionDTO:
- type* string (enum: triggerWorkflow | updateContactField | appointmentBooking | stopBot | humanHandOver | advancedFollowup | transferBot | customApi; e.g. "triggerWorkflow") - Type of action to perform
- name* string (e.g. "Trigger a Workflow") - Name of the action (3-50 characters)
- details* object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object - Action-specific details. The structure depends on the action type. For TRIGGER_WORKFLOW use triggerWorkflowDto, for UPDATE_CONTACT_FIELD use updateContactFieldDto, for APPOINTMENT_BOOKING use appointmentBookingDto, for STOP_BOT use stopBotDto, for HUMAN_HAND_OVER use humanHandOverDto, for ADVANCED_FOLLOWUP use advancedFollowupDto, for TRANSFER_BOT use transferBotDto, and for CUSTOM_API use CustomApiDetailsDTO (the API Call config).
  - option 1 triggerWorkflowDto: object
    - workflowIds* string[] (e.g. ["workflow123","workflow456"]) - Array of workflow IDs to trigger
    - triggerCondition* string (e.g. "When user requests appointment") - Condition that triggers the workflow
    - triggerMessage string (e.g. "Workflow triggered successfully") - Optional message to send when triggering the workflow
  - option 2 updateContactFieldDto: object
    - contactFieldId* string (e.g. "123") - ID of the contact field in Contacts Table
    - description* string (e.g. "Business Name") - Description of the contact field in Contacts Table
    - contactUpdateExamples string[] (default: []; e.g. ["Example 1"]) - Contact update examples in Contacts Table. Not required when using standard fields, Monetory or Date Custom fields.
  - option 3 appointmentBookingDto: object
    - actionId string (e.g. "action123") - Optional action ID reference
    - calendarId* string (e.g. "calendar123") - Calendar ID for appointment booking
    - onlySendLink* boolean - If true, only sends the appointment link without booking
    - triggerWorkflow* boolean - Whether to trigger a workflow after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
    - workflowIds string[] (e.g. ["workflow123"]) - Workflow IDs to trigger after booking (required when triggerWorkflow is true)
    - sleepAfterBooking* boolean - Whether to put the agent to sleep after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
    - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes; e.g. "hours") - Unit for sleep time (required when sleepAfterBooking is true)
    - sleepTime number (e.g. 24) - Sleep duration (required when sleepAfterBooking is true)
    - transferBot* boolean - Whether to transfer to another agent after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
    - transferAgent string (e.g. "employee456") - Agent ID to transfer to (required when transferBot is true)
    - rescheduleEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment rescheduling (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
    - cancelEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment cancellation (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
  - option 4 stopBotDto: object
    - stopBotDetectionType* string (enum: Goodbye | Custom; e.g. "Custom") - Type of stop bot detection - Goodbye or Custom
    - stopBotTriggerCondition* string (e.g. "When the user says they no longer need assistance or want to end the conversation") - Condition that triggers stopping the bot
    - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the bot can be reactivated after being stopped
    - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes; e.g. "hours") - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
    - sleepTime number (e.g. 24) - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
    - enabled* boolean - Whether this action is enabled for the agent
    - stopBotExamples* string[] (e.g. ["goodbye","thank you","no more questions"]) - Example phrases that trigger stop bot action (minimum 2 required)
    - finalMessage* string (e.g. "Thank you for contacting us. Have a great day!") - Final message sent when stopping the bot
    - tags string[] (e.g. ["resolved","no-response"]) - Tags to apply when stopping the bot
  - option 5 humanHandOverDto: object
    - enabled* boolean - Whether human handover action is enabled
    - triggerCondition* string (e.g. "When the user requests to speak with a human agent or expresses frustration") - Condition that triggers human handover
    - examples string[] (e.g. ["speak to human","talk to agent","need help from person"]) - Example phrases that trigger human handover (required when handoverType is custom or contactRequest)
    - assignToUserId string (e.g. "user123") - ID of the user to assign the conversation to
    - skipAssignToUser boolean - Whether to skip assigning to a specific user
    - createTask boolean - Whether to create a task when handing over
    - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the agent can be reactivated after handover
    - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes; e.g. "hours") - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
    - sleepTime number (e.g. 24) - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
    - finalMessage* string (e.g. "I am transferring you to a human agent who will assist you shortly.") - Final message sent when handing over to human
    - tags string[] (e.g. ["escalated","human-requested"]) - Tags to apply during handover
    - handoverType* string (enum: contactRequest | lackOfInformation | failedToResolveIssue | custom; e.g. "contactRequest") - Type of human handover detection
  - option 6 advancedFollowupDto: object

      - dynamicChannelSwitching* boolean (default: true) - Whether to dynamically switch channels for followups

        - intervals object[] - Time intervals for this day

          - startMinute* number (e.g. 0) - Start minute
          - endHour* number (e.g. 17) - End hour (24-hour format)
          - endMinute* number (e.g. 30) - End minute
      - timezoneToUse string (enum: contact | business; e.g. "contact") - Timezone to use for followups, contact or location
  - option 7 transferBotDto: object
    - transferBotType* string (enum: Default | Custom; e.g. "Custom") - Type of transfer - Default or Custom

### Create an Agent
POST /conversation-ai/agents
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/conversation-ai/agents
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/create-agent | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/create-agent.md

Creates a new AI agent for the location. The agent will be created with the specified configuration including name, role, actions, and behavior settings.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: conversation-ai.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateEmployeeDto:
- name* string (e.g. "John Doe") - Name of the agent.
- businessName string (e.g. "Tech Corp") - Name of the business the agent represents.
- mode string (enum: off | suggestive | auto-pilot; default: off; e.g. "auto-pilot") - Mode of operation - OFF, SUGGESTIVE, or AUTO_PILOT
- channels string[] (enum: IG | FB | SMS | WebChat | WhatsApp | Live_Chat | Email; e.g. ["SMS","Live_Chat","WhatsApp"]) - Communication channels the agent can operate on
- isPrimary boolean (default: false) - Indicates if this agent is a primary agent.
- waitTime number (default: 2) - Wait time before agent responds (max 5 for minutes, 300 for seconds)
- waitTimeUnit string (enum: minutes | seconds; default: seconds) - Unit for wait time - SECONDS or MINUTES
- sleepEnabled boolean (default: false; deprecated) - Indicates if sleep functionality is enabled.
- sleepOnManualMessage boolean - Enable sleep when a manual outbound message is sent.
- sleepOnWorkflowMessage boolean - Enable sleep when a workflow outbound message is sent.
- sleepTime number (e.g. 2) - Duration of sleep period (required if sleepEnabled is true). Set to null for indefinite sleep. (max 2880 for minutes, 172800 for seconds, 48 for hours)
- sleepTimeUnit string (enum: hours | minutes | seconds; e.g. "hours") - Unit of sleep time - HOURS, MINUTES, or SECONDS (required if sleepEnabled is true). Set to null for indefinite sleep.
- personality* string (e.g. "Friendly and helpful") - Personality traits of the agent.
- goal* string (e.g. "Assist customers with inquiries.") - The goal of the agent.
- instructions* string (e.g. "Provide  customer service.") - Instructions for the agent.
- fullPrompt string - Complete agent prompt. When set and non-empty, used as the source of truth at generation time instead of personality, goal, and instructions.
- autoPilotMaxMessages number (default: 75) - Maximum number of messages in auto-pilot mode before requiring human intervention. (max: 100, min: 1)
- knowledgeBaseIds string[] (e.g. ["kb_abc123","kb_def456"]) - Array of knowledge base IDs associated with this agent.
- respondToImages boolean (default: false) - Allow agent to respond to images
- respondToAudio boolean (default: false) - Allow agent to respond to audio

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- id* string - Unique identifier for the agent.
- name* string - Name of the agent.
- businessName string - Name of the business the agent represents.
- mode* string (enum: off | suggestive | auto-pilot) - Current operating mode of the agent.
- channels* string[] (enum: IG | FB | SMS | WebChat | WhatsApp | Live_Chat | Email) - Communication channels the agent operates on.
- waitTime* number - Wait time before agent responds.
- waitTimeUnit* string (enum: minutes | seconds) - Unit for wait time.
- sleepEnabled* boolean (deprecated) - Indicates if sleep functionality is enabled.
- sleepOnManualMessage boolean - Whether the bot sleeps on manual outbound messages.
- sleepOnWorkflowMessage boolean - Whether the bot sleeps on workflow outbound messages.
- sleepTime number - Duration of sleep period.
- sleepTimeUnit string (enum: hours | minutes | seconds) - Unit of sleep time.
- emailWaitTime number - Email-specific wait time (max 12 hours).
- emailWaitTimeUnit string (enum: seconds | minutes | hours) - Unit for email wait time.
- emailSettings object - Email channel formatting settings.
- actions* object[] - List of actions associated with this agent.
  - id* string - Unique identifier for the action.
  - type* string (enum: triggerWorkflow | updateContactField | appointmentBooking | stopBot | humanHandOver | advancedFollowup | transferBot | customApi) - type of action.
- isPrimary* boolean - Indicates if this agent is a primary agent.
- autoPilotMaxMessages* number - Maximum number of messages in auto-pilot mode before requiring human intervention.
- goal string - The goal of the agent.
- personality string - Personality traits of the agent.
- instructions string - Instructions for the agent.
- fullPrompt string - Complete agent prompt when stored; when set and non-empty, used as the source of truth at generation time.
- knowledgeBaseIds string[] - Array of knowledge base IDs associated with this agent.
- knowledgeBaseTriggers object[] - Knowledge base trigger configurations
  - id* string - Unique trigger ID (UUID v4)
  - mode* string (enum: all | custom) - "all" matches every query; "custom" is conditional
  - knowledgeBaseIds* string[] - KB IDs assigned to this trigger (max 7 for "all", max 5 for "custom")
  - triggerCondition* string - Free-text condition (empty string for "all" mode, required for "custom")
  - priority* number - Priority (lower number = higher priority). Custom-mode triggers must use unique values in 1-3; priority 4 is reserved for the all-mode fallback trigger.
- workingHours object (nullable) - Working-hours schedule for this agent, or null when not configured. Manage it via the /working-hours routes.
  - enabled* boolean - Master toggle for working hours.
  - channels* string[] (enum: SMS | Email | WhatsApp | IG | FB | WebChat | Live_Chat | TIKTOK) - Channels the gate applies to. Must be non-empty when enabled.
  - timezoneMode* string (enum: contact | business)

### Get Action by ID
GET /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions/{actionId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions/{actionId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/get-action-by-id | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/get-action-by-id.md

Retrieves detailed information about a specific action using its unique identifier. Returns the action configuration, associated agents, and performance metrics. Supports both classic actions and the `customApi` ("API Call") type.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: conversation-ai.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- actionId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - The unique identifier of the action ID Attached to the agent
- agentId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - The unique identifier of the AI agent

Response 200 (Success) application/json:
- data* object | object - Action details (classic action or customApi API Call action)
  - option 1 ActionDataDTO: object
    - id* string - Unique identifier for the action
    - name* string - Name of the action
    - type* string (enum: triggerWorkflow | updateContactField | appointmentBooking | stopBot | humanHandOver | advancedFollowup | transferBot | customApi) - Type of the action
    - agentId string - Agent ID where the action belongs
    - details* object | object | object | object | object | object | object - Action-specific details. The structure depends on the action type. For TRIGGER_WORKFLOW use triggerWorkflowDto, for UPDATE_CONTACT_FIELD use updateContactFieldDto, for APPOINTMENT_BOOKING use appointmentBookingDto, for STOP_BOT use stopBotDto, for HUMAN_HAND_OVER use humanHandOverDto, for ADVANCED_FOLLOWUP use advancedFollowupDto, and for TRANSFER_BOT use transferBotDto.
      - option 1 triggerWorkflowDto: object
        - workflowIds* string[] - Array of workflow IDs to trigger
        - triggerCondition* string - Condition that triggers the workflow
        - triggerMessage string - Optional message to send when triggering the workflow
      - option 2 updateContactFieldDto: object
        - contactFieldId* string - ID of the contact field in Contacts Table
        - description* string - Description of the contact field in Contacts Table
        - contactUpdateExamples string[] (default: []) - Contact update examples in Contacts Table. Not required when using standard fields, Monetory or Date Custom fields.
      - option 3 appointmentBookingDto: object
        - actionId string - Optional action ID reference
        - calendarId* string - Calendar ID for appointment booking
        - onlySendLink* boolean - If true, only sends the appointment link without booking
        - triggerWorkflow* boolean - Whether to trigger a workflow after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - workflowIds string[] - Workflow IDs to trigger after booking (required when triggerWorkflow is true)
        - sleepAfterBooking* boolean - Whether to put the agent to sleep after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Unit for sleep time (required when sleepAfterBooking is true)
        - sleepTime number - Sleep duration (required when sleepAfterBooking is true)
        - transferBot* boolean - Whether to transfer to another agent after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - transferAgent string - Agent ID to transfer to (required when transferBot is true)
        - rescheduleEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment rescheduling (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - cancelEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment cancellation (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
      - option 4 stopBotDto: object
        - stopBotDetectionType* string (enum: Goodbye | Custom) - Type of stop bot detection - Goodbye or Custom
        - stopBotTriggerCondition* string - Condition that triggers stopping the bot
        - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the bot can be reactivated after being stopped
        - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - sleepTime number - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - enabled* boolean - Whether this action is enabled for the agent
        - stopBotExamples* string[] - Example phrases that trigger stop bot action (minimum 2 required)
        - finalMessage* string - Final message sent when stopping the bot
        - tags string[] - Tags to apply when stopping the bot
      - option 5 humanHandOverDto: object
        - enabled* boolean - Whether human handover action is enabled
        - triggerCondition* string - Condition that triggers human handover
        - examples string[] - Example phrases that trigger human handover (required when handoverType is custom or contactRequest)
        - assignToUserId string - ID of the user to assign the conversation to
        - skipAssignToUser boolean - Whether to skip assigning to a specific user
        - createTask boolean - Whether to create a task when handing over
        - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the agent can be reactivated after handover
        - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - sleepTime number - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - finalMessage* string - Final message sent when handing over to human
        - tags string[] - Tags to apply during handover
        - handoverType* string (enum: contactRequest | lackOfInformation | failedToResolveIssue | custom) - Type of human handover detection
      - option 6 advancedFollowupDto: object
        - enabled* boolean - Whether advanced followup is enabled
        - scenarioId* string (enum: contactStoppedReplying | contactIsBusy | contactRequested) - ID of the followup scenario
        - followupSequence* object[] - Sequence of followup actions to perform
          - id* number - Unique identifier for this followup step
          - followupTimeUnit* string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Time unit for followup delay
          - followupTime* number - Time duration before followup (max: 60 minutes, 24 hours, or 180 days depending on unit)
          - aiEnabledMessage boolean (default: true) - Whether to use AI to generate the followup message
          - triggerWorkflow boolean (default: false) - Whether to trigger a workflow during this followup
          - customMessage string - Custom message to send (when aiEnabledMessage is false)
          - workflowId string - Workflow ID to trigger (when triggerWorkflow is true)
          - contactRequested boolean - Whether contact was requested in this followup
        - followupSettings object - Additional settings for followup behavior
          - dynamicChannelSwitching* boolean (default: true) - Whether to dynamically switch channels for followups
          - followUpHours boolean - Whether to respect working hours for followups
          - workingHours object[] - Working hours configuration for followups
            - dayOfTheWeek* number - Day of the week (0=Sunday, 1=Monday, etc.)
            - intervals object[] - Time intervals for this day
              - startHour* number - Start hour (24-hour format)
              - startMinute* number - Start minute
              - endHour* number - End hour (24-hour format)
              - endMinute* number - End minute
          - timezoneToUse string (enum: contact | business) - Timezone to use for followups, contact or location
      - option 7 transferBotDto: object
        - transferBotType* string (enum: Default | Custom) - Type of transfer - Default or Custom
        - transferToBot* string - ID of the bot/agent to transfer to
        - enabled* boolean - Whether this transfer action is enabled
        - transferBotTriggerCondition string - Condition that triggers the transfer (required for Custom type)
        - transferBotExamples string[] - Example phrases that trigger transfer (required for Custom type, minimum 2)
  - option 2 CustomApiActionDataDTO: object
    - id* string - Unique identifier for the API Call action
    - name* string - Name of the API Call action
    - type* string (enum: customApi) - Always customApi
    - agentId string - Agent ID where the action belongs
    - details object - API Call config — description, triggerCondition, and the HTTP definition (secrets redacted on read).
      - triggerCondition string (maxLength: 500) - "use this when…" rule shown to the agent. REQUIRED on CREATE (enforced in the handler) to match the builder; on UPDATE it may be OMITTED to leave it unchanged, but sending it blank is rejected.
      - description string (maxLength: 2000) - Optional description of the API Call action
      - postActionPrompt string (maxLength: 300) - Guidance the agent follows AFTER the call returns (e.g. how to phrase the reply, what not to reveal). REQUIRED on CREATE (enforced in the handler) to match the builder; on UPDATE it may be OMITTED to leave it unchanged (partial merge), but sending it blank is rejected.
      - apiConfig object - The self-contained HTTP definition. Required on CREATE (enforced in the handler). OPTIONAL on UPDATE — omit it to edit just name/description/triggerCondition. When sent on update it is merged ONE LEVEL DEEP over the stored config: top-level keys present replace the stored value, keys absent are kept, and nested objects/arrays (headers, queryParams, bodyTemplate, parameters, outputFields) are replaced whole — send the complete value, not just the entry that changed. Secrets are redacted on read; see `authentication` for how they round-trip.
        - url string - HTTPS endpoint; supports {{var}}. REQUIRED on create. Optional on update — omit it to keep the stored url (apiConfig merges by top-level key).
        - method string (enum: GET | POST | PUT | PATCH | DELETE) - HTTP method used for the call. REQUIRED on create. Optional on update — omit it to keep the stored method.
        - headers map<string, string> - Static HTTP headers sent with every call. Secrets belong in `authentication`, not here. On update this object REPLACES the stored headers — send them all, not just the changed one.
        - queryParams map<string, string> - Static query-string parameters appended to the URL.
        - bodyTemplate object - Request body template — object or raw JSON string. Supports {{variable}} placeholders.
        - parameters object - JSON Schema of LLM-supplied params
        - authentication object - Auth config; secrets stored per-instance, write-only
        - timeoutMs number - Per-request timeout in milliseconds (max 60000).
        - retryOnFailure boolean - Retry the call once on a network error or a 5xx. 4xx is never retried.
        - useSimpleRequestBody boolean - Send the body template verbatim as raw JSON instead of building it from the parameter schema.
        - outputFields string[] - Dot-paths of the response fields handed back to the agent. Omit to return the whole body; use [] notation for arrays, e.g. `result[].id`.
        - sampleResponse object - Trimmed sample of a real response (editor Test tab). Prompt-only — inlined so the agent knows the response shape; never executed. Secrets are masked on read.
- success* boolean - Success status of the request

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

- sleepOnWorkflowMessage boolean - Whether the bot sleeps on workflow outbound messages.

List for actions for an agent, including any `customApi` ("API Call") actions.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: conversation-ai.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- agentId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - The unique identifier of the AI agent

Response 200 (Success) application/json:
- data* (object | object)[] - Actions for the agent — classic actions and customApi (API Call) actions
  - option 1 ActionDataDTO: object
    - id* string - Unique identifier for the action
    - name* string - Name of the action
    - type* string (enum: triggerWorkflow | updateContactField | appointmentBooking | stopBot | humanHandOver | advancedFollowup | transferBot | customApi) - Type of the action
    - agentId string - Agent ID where the action belongs
    - details* object | object | object | object | object | object | object - Action-specific details. The structure depends on the action type. For TRIGGER_WORKFLOW use triggerWorkflowDto, for UPDATE_CONTACT_FIELD use updateContactFieldDto, for APPOINTMENT_BOOKING use appointmentBookingDto, for STOP_BOT use stopBotDto, for HUMAN_HAND_OVER use humanHandOverDto, for ADVANCED_FOLLOWUP use advancedFollowupDto, and for TRANSFER_BOT use transferBotDto.
      - option 1 triggerWorkflowDto: object
        - workflowIds* string[] - Array of workflow IDs to trigger
        - triggerCondition* string - Condition that triggers the workflow
        - triggerMessage string - Optional message to send when triggering the workflow
      - option 2 updateContactFieldDto: object
        - contactFieldId* string - ID of the contact field in Contacts Table
        - description* string - Description of the contact field in Contacts Table
        - contactUpdateExamples string[] (default: []) - Contact update examples in Contacts Table. Not required when using standard fields, Monetory or Date Custom fields.
      - option 3 appointmentBookingDto: object
        - actionId string - Optional action ID reference
        - calendarId* string - Calendar ID for appointment booking
        - onlySendLink* boolean - If true, only sends the appointment link without booking
        - triggerWorkflow* boolean - Whether to trigger a workflow after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - workflowIds string[] - Workflow IDs to trigger after booking (required when triggerWorkflow is true)
        - sleepAfterBooking* boolean - Whether to put the agent to sleep after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Unit for sleep time (required when sleepAfterBooking is true)
        - sleepTime number - Sleep duration (required when sleepAfterBooking is true)
        - transferBot* boolean - Whether to transfer to another agent after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - transferAgent string - Agent ID to transfer to (required when transferBot is true)
        - rescheduleEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment rescheduling (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - cancelEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment cancellation (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
      - option 4 stopBotDto: object
        - stopBotDetectionType* string (enum: Goodbye | Custom) - Type of stop bot detection - Goodbye or Custom
        - stopBotTriggerCondition* string - Condition that triggers stopping the bot
        - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the bot can be reactivated after being stopped
        - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - sleepTime number - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - enabled* boolean - Whether this action is enabled for the agent
        - stopBotExamples* string[] - Example phrases that trigger stop bot action (minimum 2 required)
        - finalMessage* string - Final message sent when stopping the bot
        - tags string[] - Tags to apply when stopping the bot
      - option 5 humanHandOverDto: object
        - enabled* boolean - Whether human handover action is enabled
        - triggerCondition* string - Condition that triggers human handover
        - examples string[] - Example phrases that trigger human handover (required when handoverType is custom or contactRequest)
        - assignToUserId string - ID of the user to assign the conversation to
        - skipAssignToUser boolean - Whether to skip assigning to a specific user
        - createTask boolean - Whether to create a task when handing over
        - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the agent can be reactivated after handover
        - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - sleepTime number - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - finalMessage* string - Final message sent when handing over to human
        - tags string[] - Tags to apply during handover
        - handoverType* string (enum: contactRequest | lackOfInformation | failedToResolveIssue | custom) - Type of human handover detection
      - option 6 advancedFollowupDto: object
        - enabled* boolean - Whether advanced followup is enabled
        - scenarioId* string (enum: contactStoppedReplying | contactIsBusy | contactRequested) - ID of the followup scenario
        - followupSequence* object[] - Sequence of followup actions to perform
          - id* number - Unique identifier for this followup step
          - followupTimeUnit* string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Time unit for followup delay
          - followupTime* number - Time duration before followup (max: 60 minutes, 24 hours, or 180 days depending on unit)
          - aiEnabledMessage boolean (default: true) - Whether to use AI to generate the followup message
          - triggerWorkflow boolean (default: false) - Whether to trigger a workflow during this followup
          - customMessage string - Custom message to send (when aiEnabledMessage is false)
          - workflowId string - Workflow ID to trigger (when triggerWorkflow is true)
          - contactRequested boolean - Whether contact was requested in this followup
        - followupSettings object - Additional settings for followup behavior
          - dynamicChannelSwitching* boolean (default: true) - Whether to dynamically switch channels for followups
          - followUpHours boolean - Whether to respect working hours for followups
          - workingHours object[] - Working hours configuration for followups
            - dayOfTheWeek* number - Day of the week (0=Sunday, 1=Monday, etc.)
            - intervals object[] - Time intervals for this day
              - startHour* number - Start hour (24-hour format)
              - startMinute* number - Start minute
              - endHour* number - End hour (24-hour format)
              - endMinute* number - End minute
          - timezoneToUse string (enum: contact | business) - Timezone to use for followups, contact or location
      - option 7 transferBotDto: object
        - transferBotType* string (enum: Default | Custom) - Type of transfer - Default or Custom
        - transferToBot* string - ID of the bot/agent to transfer to
        - enabled* boolean - Whether this transfer action is enabled
        - transferBotTriggerCondition string - Condition that triggers the transfer (required for Custom type)
        - transferBotExamples string[] - Example phrases that trigger transfer (required for Custom type, minimum 2)
  - option 2 CustomApiActionDataDTO: object
    - id* string - Unique identifier for the API Call action
    - name* string - Name of the API Call action
    - type* string (enum: customApi) - Always customApi
    - agentId string - Agent ID where the action belongs
    - details object - API Call config — description, triggerCondition, and the HTTP definition (secrets redacted on read).
      - triggerCondition string (maxLength: 500) - "use this when…" rule shown to the agent. REQUIRED on CREATE (enforced in the handler) to match the builder; on UPDATE it may be OMITTED to leave it unchanged, but sending it blank is rejected.
      - description string (maxLength: 2000) - Optional description of the API Call action
      - postActionPrompt string (maxLength: 300) - Guidance the agent follows AFTER the call returns (e.g. how to phrase the reply, what not to reveal). REQUIRED on CREATE (enforced in the handler) to match the builder; on UPDATE it may be OMITTED to leave it unchanged (partial merge), but sending it blank is rejected.
      - apiConfig object - The self-contained HTTP definition. Required on CREATE (enforced in the handler). OPTIONAL on UPDATE — omit it to edit just name/description/triggerCondition. When sent on update it is merged ONE LEVEL DEEP over the stored config: top-level keys present replace the stored value, keys absent are kept, and nested objects/arrays (headers, queryParams, bodyTemplate, parameters, outputFields) are replaced whole — send the complete value, not just the entry that changed. Secrets are redacted on read; see `authentication` for how they round-trip.
        - url string - HTTPS endpoint; supports {{var}}. REQUIRED on create. Optional on update — omit it to keep the stored url (apiConfig merges by top-level key).
        - method string (enum: GET | POST | PUT | PATCH | DELETE) - HTTP method used for the call. REQUIRED on create. Optional on update — omit it to keep the stored method.
        - headers map<string, string> - Static HTTP headers sent with every call. Secrets belong in `authentication`, not here. On update this object REPLACES the stored headers — send them all, not just the changed one.
        - queryParams map<string, string> - Static query-string parameters appended to the URL.
        - bodyTemplate object - Request body template — object or raw JSON string. Supports {{variable}} placeholders.
        - parameters object - JSON Schema of LLM-supplied params
        - authentication object - Auth config; secrets stored per-instance, write-only
        - timeoutMs number - Per-request timeout in milliseconds (max 60000).
        - retryOnFailure boolean - Retry the call once on a network error or a 5xx. 4xx is never retried.
        - useSimpleRequestBody boolean - Send the body template verbatim as raw JSON instead of building it from the parameter schema.
        - outputFields string[] - Dot-paths of the response fields handed back to the agent. Omit to return the whole body; use [] notation for arrays, e.g. `result[].id`.
        - sampleResponse object - Trimmed sample of a real response (editor Test tab). Prompt-only — inlined so the agent knows the response shape; never executed. Secrets are masked on read.
- success* boolean - Success status of the request

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Search Agents
GET /conversation-ai/agents/search
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/conversation-ai/agents/search
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/search-agent | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/search-agent.md

Searches for AI agents based on various criteria including name, status, and configuration. Supports advanced filtering and full-text search capabilities.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: conversation-ai.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- startAfter string (e.g. "Exampleee123") - Start after is the agent id to start after, Serving as skip, send empty when first page
- limit number (e.g. 1) - Records per page
- query string (e.g. "booking") - query to search on agent name, must be provided in lowercase

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- agents* object[] - List of agents matching the search criteria.
  - id* string - Unique identifier for the agent.
  - name* string - Name of the agent.
  - businessName string - Name of the business the agent represents.
  - mode* string (enum: off | suggestive | auto-pilot) - Current operating mode of the agent.
  - channels* string[] - Communication channels the agent operates on.
  - waitTime* number - Wait time before agent responds.
  - waitTimeUnit* string (enum: minutes | seconds) - Unit for wait time.
  - sleepEnabled* boolean (deprecated) - Indicates if sleep functionality is enabled.
  - sleepOnManualMessage boolean - Whether the bot sleeps on manual outbound messages.
  - sleepOnWorkflowMessage boolean - Whether the bot sleeps on workflow outbound messages.
  - sleepTime number - Duration of sleep period.
  - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: hours | minutes | seconds) - Unit of sleep time.
  - actions* object[] - List of actions associated with this agent.
  - isPrimary* boolean - Indicates if this agent is a primary agent. (First agent created for a location is primary by default)
  - autoPilotMaxMessages* number - Maximum number of messages in auto-pilot mode before requiring human intervention.
  - goal object - Goal configuration for the agent.
  - knowledgeBaseIds string[] - Array of knowledge base IDs associated with this agent.
  - createdAt* string - Timestamp when the agent was created.
  - updatedAt* string - Timestamp when the agent was last updated.
- totalCount* number - Total number of agents in the location (unfiltered count).
- count* number - Number of agents in the current response (filtered/paginated count).

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Update Action
PUT /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions/{actionId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions/{actionId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/update-action | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/update-action.md

Updates an existing action's configuration — name, description, trigger condition and behaviour settings. For `customApi` ("API Call") actions `details.apiConfig` is optional: omit it to leave the HTTP definition untouched. When sent, it is merged ONE LEVEL DEEP over the stored config — a top-level key you send replaces the stored value outright, keys you omit are kept. Nested values (`headers`, `queryParams`, `bodyTemplate`, `parameters`, `outputFields`) are replaced whole, so send the complete object rather than just the entry you changed. `authentication` is the exception: secret fields omitted, or returned as the redacted placeholder, keep the stored secret.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: conversation-ai.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- actionId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - The unique identifier of the action ID Attached to the agent
- agentId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - The unique identifier of the AI agent

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateActionDTO:
- type* string (enum: triggerWorkflow | updateContactField | appointmentBooking | stopBot | humanHandOver | advancedFollowup | transferBot | customApi; e.g. "triggerWorkflow") - Type of action to perform
- name* string (e.g. "Trigger a Workflow") - Name of the action (3-50 characters)
- details* object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object - Action-specific details. The structure depends on the action type. For TRIGGER_WORKFLOW use triggerWorkflowDto, for UPDATE_CONTACT_FIELD use updateContactFieldDto, for APPOINTMENT_BOOKING use appointmentBookingDto, for STOP_BOT use stopBotDto, for HUMAN_HAND_OVER use humanHandOverDto, for ADVANCED_FOLLOWUP use advancedFollowupDto, for TRANSFER_BOT use transferBotDto, and for CUSTOM_API use CustomApiDetailsDTO (the API Call config).
  - option 1 triggerWorkflowDto: object
    - workflowIds* string[] (e.g. ["workflow123","workflow456"]) - Array of workflow IDs to trigger
    - triggerCondition* string (e.g. "When user requests appointment") - Condition that triggers the workflow
    - triggerMessage string (e.g. "Workflow triggered successfully") - Optional message to send when triggering the workflow
  - option 2 updateContactFieldDto: object
    - contactFieldId* string (e.g. "123") - ID of the contact field in Contacts Table
    - description* string (e.g. "Business Name") - Description of the contact field in Contacts Table
    - contactUpdateExamples string[] (default: []; e.g. ["Example 1"]) - Contact update examples in Contacts Table. Not required when using standard fields, Monetory or Date Custom fields.
  - option 3 appointmentBookingDto: object
    - actionId string (e.g. "action123") - Optional action ID reference
    - calendarId* string (e.g. "calendar123") - Calendar ID for appointment booking
    - onlySendLink* boolean - If true, only sends the appointment link without booking
    - triggerWorkflow* boolean - Whether to trigger a workflow after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
    - workflowIds string[] (e.g. ["workflow123"]) - Workflow IDs to trigger after booking (required when triggerWorkflow is true)
    - sleepAfterBooking* boolean - Whether to put the agent to sleep after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
    - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes; e.g. "hours") - Unit for sleep time (required when sleepAfterBooking is true)
    - sleepTime number (e.g. 24) - Sleep duration (required when sleepAfterBooking is true)
    - transferBot* boolean - Whether to transfer to another agent after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
    - transferAgent string (e.g. "employee456") - Agent ID to transfer to (required when transferBot is true)
    - rescheduleEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment rescheduling (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
    - cancelEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment cancellation (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
  - option 4 stopBotDto: object
    - stopBotDetectionType* string (enum: Goodbye | Custom; e.g. "Custom") - Type of stop bot detection - Goodbye or Custom
    - stopBotTriggerCondition* string (e.g. "When the user says they no longer need assistance or want to end the conversation") - Condition that triggers stopping the bot
    - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the bot can be reactivated after being stopped
    - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes; e.g. "hours") - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
    - sleepTime number (e.g. 24) - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
    - enabled* boolean - Whether this action is enabled for the agent
    - stopBotExamples* string[] (e.g. ["goodbye","thank you","no more questions"]) - Example phrases that trigger stop bot action (minimum 2 required)
    - finalMessage* string (e.g. "Thank you for contacting us. Have a great day!") - Final message sent when stopping the bot
    - tags string[] (e.g. ["resolved","no-response"]) - Tags to apply when stopping the bot
  - option 5 humanHandOverDto: object
    - enabled* boolean - Whether human handover action is enabled
    - triggerCondition* string (e.g. "When the user requests to speak with a human agent or expresses frustration") - Condition that triggers human handover
    - examples string[] (e.g. ["speak to human","talk to agent","need help from person"]) - Example phrases that trigger human handover (required when handoverType is custom or contactRequest)
    - assignToUserId string (e.g. "user123") - ID of the user to assign the conversation to
    - skipAssignToUser boolean - Whether to skip assigning to a specific user
    - createTask boolean - Whether to create a task when handing over
    - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the agent can be reactivated after handover
    - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes; e.g. "hours") - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
    - sleepTime number (e.g. 24) - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
    - finalMessage* string (e.g. "I am transferring you to a human agent who will assist you shortly.") - Final message sent when handing over to human
    - tags string[] (e.g. ["escalated","human-requested"]) - Tags to apply during handover
    - handoverType* string (enum: contactRequest | lackOfInformation | failedToResolveIssue | custom; e.g. "contactRequest") - Type of human handover detection
  - option 6 advancedFollowupDto: object

        - dayOfTheWeek* number (e.g. 1) - Day of the week (0=Sunday, 1=Monday, etc.)

### Update Agent
PUT /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/update-agent | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/update-agent.md

Updates an existing AI agent's configuration. All fields in the agent configuration can be updated including name, status, actions, and behavior settings.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: conversation-ai.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- agentId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Conversations AI agent id

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateEmployeeDto:
- name string (e.g. "John Doe") - Name of the agent.
- businessName string (e.g. "Tech Corp") - Name of the business the agent represents.
- mode string (enum: off | suggestive | auto-pilot; e.g. "auto-pilot") - Mode of operation for the agent, required if primary is enabled.
- channels string[] (enum: IG | FB | SMS | WebChat | WhatsApp | Live_Chat | Email; e.g. ["SMS","Live_Chat"]) - Channels the agent can use.
- isPrimary boolean - Indicates if this agent is a primary agent.
- waitTime number (e.g. 30) - Wait time before agent responds (max 5 for minutes, 300 for seconds).
- waitTimeUnit string (enum: minutes | seconds; e.g. "seconds") - Unit for wait time - SECONDS or MINUTES
- sleepEnabled boolean (deprecated) - Indicates if sleep functionality is enabled.
- sleepOnManualMessage boolean - Enable sleep when a manual outbound message is sent.
- sleepOnWorkflowMessage boolean - Enable sleep when a workflow outbound message is sent.
- sleepTime number (e.g. 10) - Duration of sleep period (required if sleepEnabled is true). Set to null for indefinite sleep. (max 2880 for minutes, 172800 for seconds, 48 for hours)
- sleepTimeUnit string (enum: hours | minutes | seconds; e.g. "hours") - Unit of sleep time - HOURS, MINUTES, or SECONDS (required if sleepEnabled is true). Set to null for indefinite sleep.
- personality string (e.g. "You re an AI assistant and you are friendly and helpful") - Personality traits of the agent.
- goal string (e.g. "You are an AI assistant and you are helping customers with inquiries.") - The goal of the agent.
- instructions string (e.g. "Provide excellent customer service.") - Instructions for the agent.
- fullPrompt string - Complete agent prompt. When set and non-empty, used as the source of truth at generation time instead of personality, goal, and instructions.
- autoPilotMaxMessages* number (default: 75) - Maximum number of messages in auto-pilot mode before requiring human intervention. (max: 100, min: 1)
- knowledgeBaseIds string[] (e.g. ["kb_abc123","kb_def456"]) - Array of knowledge base IDs associated with this agent.
- respondToImages boolean (default: false) - Allow agent to respond to images
- respondToAudio boolean (default: false) - Allow agent to respond to audio

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- id* string - Unique identifier for the agent.
- name* string - Name of the agent.
- businessName string - Name of the business the agent represents.
- mode* string (enum: off | suggestive | auto-pilot) - Current operating mode of the agent.
- channels* string[] (enum: IG | FB | SMS | WebChat | WhatsApp | Live_Chat | Email) - Communication channels the agent operates on.
- waitTime* number - Wait time before agent responds.
- waitTimeUnit* string (enum: minutes | seconds) - Unit for wait time.
- sleepEnabled* boolean (deprecated) - Indicates if sleep functionality is enabled.
- sleepOnManualMessage boolean - Whether the bot sleeps on manual outbound messages.
- sleepOnWorkflowMessage boolean - Whether the bot sleeps on workflow outbound messages.
- sleepTime number - Duration of sleep period.
- sleepTimeUnit string (enum: hours | minutes | seconds) - Unit of sleep time.
- emailWaitTime number - Email-specific wait time (max 12 hours).
- emailWaitTimeUnit string (enum: seconds | minutes | hours) - Unit for email wait time.
- emailSettings object - Email channel formatting settings.
- actions* object[] - List of actions associated with this agent.
  - id* string - Unique identifier for the action.

### Update Followup Settings
PATCH /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/followup-settings
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/followup-settings
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/update-followup-settings | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/update-followup-settings.md

Update the followup settings for an action

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: conversation-ai.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- agentId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - The unique identifier of the AI agent

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateFollowupSettingsDTO:
- actionIds* string[] (e.g. ["edxcfghbnjkimd"]) - Array of action IDs to update followup settings for
- followupSettings* object - Followup settings configuration to apply to the specified actions
  - dynamicChannelSwitching* boolean (default: true) - Whether to dynamically switch channels for followups
  - followUpHours boolean - Whether to respect working hours for followups
  - workingHours object[] - Working hours configuration for followups
    - dayOfTheWeek* number (e.g. 1) - Day of the week (0=Sunday, 1=Monday, etc.)
    - intervals object[] - Time intervals for this day
      - startHour* number (e.g. 9) - Start hour (24-hour format)
      - startMinute* number (e.g. 0) - Start minute
      - endHour* number (e.g. 17) - End hour (24-hour format)
      - endMinute* number (e.g. 30) - End minute
  - timezoneToUse string (enum: contact | business; e.g. "contact") - Timezone to use for followups, contact or location

Response 200 (Success) application/json:
- data* object | object - Updated action details (classic action or customApi API Call action)
  - option 1 ActionDataDTO: object
    - id* string - Unique identifier for the action
    - name* string - Name of the action
    - type* string (enum: triggerWorkflow | updateContactField | appointmentBooking | stopBot | humanHandOver | advancedFollowup | transferBot | customApi) - Type of the action
    - agentId string - Agent ID where the action belongs
    - details* object | object | object | object | object | object | object - Action-specific details. The structure depends on the action type. For TRIGGER_WORKFLOW use triggerWorkflowDto, for UPDATE_CONTACT_FIELD use updateContactFieldDto, for APPOINTMENT_BOOKING use appointmentBookingDto, for STOP_BOT use stopBotDto, for HUMAN_HAND_OVER use humanHandOverDto, for ADVANCED_FOLLOWUP use advancedFollowupDto, and for TRANSFER_BOT use transferBotDto.
      - option 1 triggerWorkflowDto: object
        - workflowIds* string[] - Array of workflow IDs to trigger
        - triggerCondition* string - Condition that triggers the workflow
        - triggerMessage string - Optional message to send when triggering the workflow
      - option 2 updateContactFieldDto: object
        - contactFieldId* string - ID of the contact field in Contacts Table
        - description* string - Description of the contact field in Contacts Table
        - contactUpdateExamples string[] (default: []) - Contact update examples in Contacts Table. Not required when using standard fields, Monetory or Date Custom fields.
      - option 3 appointmentBookingDto: object
        - actionId string - Optional action ID reference
        - calendarId* string - Calendar ID for appointment booking
        - onlySendLink* boolean - If true, only sends the appointment link without booking
        - triggerWorkflow* boolean - Whether to trigger a workflow after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - workflowIds string[] - Workflow IDs to trigger after booking (required when triggerWorkflow is true)
        - sleepAfterBooking* boolean - Whether to put the agent to sleep after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Unit for sleep time (required when sleepAfterBooking is true)
        - sleepTime number - Sleep duration (required when sleepAfterBooking is true)
        - transferBot* boolean - Whether to transfer to another agent after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - transferAgent string - Agent ID to transfer to (required when transferBot is true)
        - rescheduleEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment rescheduling (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - cancelEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment cancellation (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
      - option 4 stopBotDto: object
        - stopBotDetectionType* string (enum: Goodbye | Custom) - Type of stop bot detection - Goodbye or Custom
        - stopBotTriggerCondition* string - Condition that triggers stopping the bot
        - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the bot can be reactivated after being stopped
        - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - sleepTime number - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - enabled* boolean - Whether this action is enabled for the agent
        - stopBotExamples* string[] - Example phrases that trigger stop bot action (minimum 2 required)
        - finalMessage* string - Final message sent when stopping the bot
        - tags string[] - Tags to apply when stopping the bot
      - option 5 humanHandOverDto: object
        - enabled* boolean - Whether human handover action is enabled
        - triggerCondition* string - Condition that triggers human handover
        - examples string[] - Example phrases that trigger human handover (required when handoverType is custom or contactRequest)
        - assignToUserId string - ID of the user to assign the conversation to
        - skipAssignToUser boolean - Whether to skip assigning to a specific user
        - createTask boolean - Whether to create a task when handing over
        - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the agent can be reactivated after handover
        - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - sleepTime number - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - finalMessage* string - Final message sent when handing over to human
        - tags string[] - Tags to apply during handover
        - handoverType* string (enum: contactRequest | lackOfInformation | failedToResolveIssue | custom) - Type of human handover detection
      - option 6 advancedFollowupDto: object
        - enabled* boolean - Whether advanced followup is enabled
        - scenarioId* string (enum: contactStoppedReplying | contactIsBusy | contactRequested) - ID of the followup scenario
        - followupSequence* object[] - Sequence of followup actions to perform
          - id* number - Unique identifier for this followup step
          - followupTimeUnit* string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Time unit for followup delay
          - followupTime* number - Time duration before followup (max: 60 minutes, 24 hours, or 180 days depending on unit)
          - aiEnabledMessage boolean (default: true) - Whether to use AI to generate the followup message
          - triggerWorkflow boolean (default: false) - Whether to trigger a workflow during this followup
          - customMessage string - Custom message to send (when aiEnabledMessage is false)
          - workflowId string - Workflow ID to trigger (when triggerWorkflow is true)
          - contactRequested boolean - Whether contact was requested in this followup
        - followupSettings object - Additional settings for followup behavior
          - dynamicChannelSwitching* boolean (default: true) - Whether to dynamically switch channels for followups
          - followUpHours boolean - Whether to respect working hours for followups
          - workingHours object[] - Working hours configuration for followups
            - dayOfTheWeek* number - Day of the week (0=Sunday, 1=Monday, etc.)
            - intervals object[] - Time intervals for this day
              - startHour* number - Start hour (24-hour format)
              - startMinute* number - Start minute
              - endHour* number - End hour (24-hour format)
              - endMinute* number - End minute
          - timezoneToUse string (enum: contact | business) - Timezone to use for followups, contact or location
      - option 7 transferBotDto: object
        - transferBotType* string (enum: Default | Custom) - Type of transfer - Default or Custom
        - transferToBot* string - ID of the bot/agent to transfer to
        - enabled* boolean - Whether this transfer action is enabled
        - transferBotTriggerCondition string - Condition that triggers the transfer (required for Custom type)
        - transferBotExamples string[] - Example phrases that trigger transfer (required for Custom type, minimum 2)
  - option 2 CustomApiActionDataDTO: object
    - id* string - Unique identifier for the API Call action
    - name* string - Name of the API Call action
    - type* string (enum: customApi) - Always customApi
    - agentId string - Agent ID where the action belongs
    - details object - API Call config — description, triggerCondition, and the HTTP definition (secrets redacted on read).
      - triggerCondition string (maxLength: 500) - "use this when…" rule shown to the agent. REQUIRED on CREATE (enforced in the handler) to match the builder; on UPDATE it may be OMITTED to leave it unchanged, but sending it blank is rejected.
      - description string (maxLength: 2000) - Optional description of the API Call action
      - postActionPrompt string (maxLength: 300) - Guidance the agent follows AFTER the call returns (e.g. how to phrase the reply, what not to reveal). REQUIRED on CREATE (enforced in the handler) to match the builder; on UPDATE it may be OMITTED to leave it unchanged (partial merge), but sending it blank is rejected.
      - apiConfig object - The self-contained HTTP definition. Required on CREATE (enforced in the handler). OPTIONAL on UPDATE — omit it to edit just name/description/triggerCondition. When sent on update it is merged ONE LEVEL DEEP over the stored config: top-level keys present replace the stored value, keys absent are kept, and nested objects/arrays (headers, queryParams, bodyTemplate, parameters, outputFields) are replaced whole — send the complete value, not just the entry that changed. Secrets are redacted on read; see `authentication` for how they round-trip.
        - url string - HTTPS endpoint; supports {{var}}. REQUIRED on create. Optional on update — omit it to keep the stored url (apiConfig merges by top-level key).
        - method string (enum: GET | POST | PUT | PATCH | DELETE) - HTTP method used for the call. REQUIRED on create. Optional on update — omit it to keep the stored method.
        - headers map<string, string> - Static HTTP headers sent with every call. Secrets belong in `authentication`, not here. On update this object REPLACES the stored headers — send them all, not just the changed one.
        - queryParams map<string, string> - Static query-string parameters appended to the URL.
        - bodyTemplate object - Request body template — object or raw JSON string. Supports {{variable}} placeholders.
        - parameters object - JSON Schema of LLM-supplied params
        - authentication object - Auth config; secrets stored per-instance, write-only
        - timeoutMs number - Per-request timeout in milliseconds (max 60000).
        - retryOnFailure boolean - Retry the call once on a network error or a 5xx. 4xx is never retried.
        - useSimpleRequestBody boolean - Send the body template verbatim as raw JSON instead of building it from the parameter schema.
        - outputFields string[] - Dot-paths of the response fields handed back to the agent. Omit to return the whole body; use [] notation for arrays, e.g. `result[].id`.
        - sampleResponse object - Trimmed sample of a real response (editor Test tab). Prompt-only — inlined so the agent knows the response shape; never executed. Secrets are masked on read.
- success* boolean - Success status of the request

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
